langStringTextType.text: Identifies the executor and process type, declares the system boundary, and specifies the process inputs and outputs through a list of Recipes. GHG emission quantification is handled separately in MCFEmissions.
Identifies who or what performs this process. Where the resource has a deployed AAS, ExecutorRef enables navigation to its digital twin.
Classifies the executor by its fundamental nature. Allowed values: Equipment, Person, Space, System.
Serves as the primary identification label when ExecutorRef is absent, and as a complementary display name when ExecutorRef is present.
Expressed as a ModelReference with key type AssetAdministrationShell. Optional when the executor does not have a deployed AAS.

Specifies the physical boundaries of the assessment by referencing the first and last unit process in scope. Complements LifeCyclePhase in MCFEmissions by identifying the specific process range within the A3 manufacturing range.
Expressed as a ModelReference with key type AAS or SubmodelElements. Corresponds to the input gate of the Gate-to-Gate boundary declaration.
Expressed as a ModelReference with key type AAS or SubmodelElements. Corresponds to the output gate of the Gate-to-Gate boundary declaration.
Each SMC element represents one recipe associated with one output type. In mixed-model production, one SMC instance exists per output type.

Recorded in ISO 8601 format. Together with EndTime, defines the duration of this recipe run, which serves as the time-proportional basis for allocation of ancillary input and residual output contributions in MCFEmissions.
Recorded in ISO 8601 format. The interval between StartTime and EntTime represents the total processing time attributable to this recipe run.

Each SMC element represents one item type consumed per unit of output. Item identity is resolved from an external MBOM via ItemRef. Energy carriers and ancillary inputs are excluded and recorded in AncillaryInputs.

Points to the corresponding item in an external MBOM via ModelReference, enabling inheritance of item identity, specification, and unit mass without duplication. Optional when an external MBOM AAS is not yet available.
Serves as the primary identification label when ItemRef is absent, and as a complementary display name when ItemRef is present.
Shall be consistent with the physical nature of the item declared in ItemRef or ItemName. Allowed values: g, kg, ml, l, EA, m, m^2
Expressed as kgCO2eq per declared AmountUnit. Represents the embodied carbon intensity of this process input item. Derived from the source referenced in EmissionFactorRef.
Points to the corresponding entry in an external LCI database - such as Ecoinvent - that provides the embodied carbon emission factor for this process input item via ExternalReference.

Points to the PCF Submodel of the input item's AAS via ModelReference with key type Submodel. Enables traceability of the embodied carbon of this item from its upstream manufacturing process into this unit process.

Each SMC element represents one output item type produced by this recipe run. Item identity is resolved from an external AAS via ItemRef. Non-intended outputs such as waste and releases are excluded and recorded in Residuals.
Points to the AAS of the output product or sub-assembly via ModelReference, enabling downstream processes to trace this output as their input and supporting cross-process material flow continuity.
Serves as the primary identification label when ItemRef is absent, and as a complementary display name when ItemRef is present.
Records the quantity of this item produced in this recipe run. Covers any measurable dimension - mass, volume, or count - depending on the physical nature of the output item.
Shall be consistent with the physical nature of the output item declared in ItemRef or ItemName. Allowed values: EA, kg, m, m^2

Covers combustion fuels and purchased heat inputs, classified as primary energy per ISO 14044 4.2. Includes direct combustion sources (LNG, LPG, diesel, kerosene - GHG Protocol Scope1) and purchased thermal energy (steam, hot water - GHG Protocol Scope 2).

langStringDefinitionTypeIec61360.text: A unit process in which raw materials, intermediate products, energy carriers, and acillary inputs are transformed or assembled to yield one or more intended outputs (ISO 14044:2006, 3.35)

langStringTextType.text: Covers non-product inputs as defined in ISO 14044:2006, structured into six categories following GHG Protocol, IEA, and Ecoinvent classification frameworks. Excludes process materials and components managed in Recipes/InputBOM.

langStringDefinitionTypeIec61360.text: Inputs consumed by this unit process that are not physically incorporated into the output product, comprising energy carriers, purchased electricity, water, industrial gases, chemicals, and other ancillary substances.
The entity that executes this unit process, classified as equipment, person, space, or software system (ISA-95 Part2)
The category of the entity responsible for executing this unit process.
The human-readable designation of the entity executing this unit process.
A reference to the Asset Administration Shell of the entity executing this unit process.
The declared scope of unit processes included in this MCF assessment, defined by a start point and an end point within the manufacturing system.
A reference to the first unit process at which material and energy inputs enter the declared system boundary.
A reference to the last unit process at which products, co-products, waste, and releases leave the declared system boundary.
Identification of a group of manufacturing procedures with comparable characteristics
summed duration of time interval for which an item was in an operating state

An ordered list of manufacturing recipes executed by this unit process during the assessment period, each speficying the process inputs consumed and the processing time engaged to product a given output type.
The timestamp at which this recipe run commenced.
The timestamp at which this recipe run was completed.

langStringTextType.text: Each SMC element represents one item type consumed per unit of output. Item identity is resolved from an external MBOM via ItemRef. Energy carries and ancillary inputs are excluded and recorded in AncillaryInputs.

langStringDefinitionTypeIec61360.text: The list of items consumed as process inputs in this recipe run, covering raw materials, components, and semi-finished products.
A reference to the corresponding item entry in an external source that formally defines this item.
name or short description of the product

langStringTextType.text: Records the quantity of this item consumed per unit of output in this recipe run. Covers any measurable dimension - mass, volume, or count - depending on the physical nature of the item.

langStringDefinitionTypeIec61360.text: The measured quantity of an item, expressed as number of pieces, mass, or volume(IEC 61360).
The unit of measure in which the Amount is expressed.

langStringTextType.text: Expressed as kgCO2 eq per declared AmountUnit. Represents the embodied carbon intensity of this process input item. Derived from the source referenced in EmissionFactorRef.

langStringDefinitionTypeIec61360.text: The emission factor used to convert the consumed amount of this item into CO2 equivalent greenhouse gas emissions.
A reference to the authoritative source from which the emission factor value in RefImpactUnitforCalculation is derived.
A reference to the Product Carbon Footprint submodel of the AAS representing this input item.
The list of intended output items produces by this recipe run.
The list of thermal and chemical energy carriers consumed by this unit process during the assessment period.
The list of purchased electricity inputs consumed by this unit process during the assessment period.
The list of water inputs consumed by this unit process during the assessment period.
The list of industrial gas inputs consumed by this unit process during the assessment period.
The list of chemical substance inputs consumed by this unit process during the assessment period.
A list of inputs that do not belong to any of the explicity defined categories within AncillaryInputs.
describes the target, which should be descibed in the block 'Climate Change' or 'Product Carbon Footprint'

langStringPreferredNameTypeIec61360.text: CC impact assessment method / calculation method

langStringDefinitionTypeIec61360.text: standard, method for determining the greenhouse gas emissions of a product
